Connection.description: An arc from a port of the unit that owns it to another unit's port.

directed.description: False builds an undirected arc between the two ports.
directed.title: Directed

index.description: Name of a set element to index the arc over; omitted: the owning unit's index, if it has one.
index.title: Index

name.description: Name of the arc on the model; omitted: derived from the endpoints.
name.title: Name

port.description: Port on the owning unit, e.g. 'outlet'.
port.title: Port

to.description: Destination as '<unit element name>.<port path>'; may contain '{i}' for an indexed connection.
to.title: To

Connection.title: Connection

CostingElement.description: The costing package: tariff, prices, demand response and finance terms.

consumption_estimate.description: Estimated total consumption over the horizon, keyed by EECO utility ('electric'/'gas'; kWh / m^3). EECO needs it to price any tier other than a flat top tier.
consumption_estimate.title: Consumption Estimate

currency.description: Currency basis to use when no tariff is given; a tariff's own currency basis always wins.
currency.title: Currency

discount_rate.description: Annual discount rate (fraction, e.g. 0.08 = 8%). Used alone as the effective rate when interest_rate is unset; otherwise it deflates interest_rate into a real effective rate. An effective rate of 0 falls back to straight-line 1/lifetime.
discount_rate.title: Discount Rate

energy_prices.description: Optional native prices keyed by carrier or fuel name ('electrical', or a fuel such as 'natural_gas'). A carrier priced here is billed at that price instead of through the tariff, so a run with every carrier priced needs no tariff at all. Each price is flat over the horizon or given per time point.
energy_prices.title: Energy Prices

fixed_operating_cost.description: Fixed operating cost over the horizon, in the currency basis in force (a tariff's own, else 'currency'): non-tariff costs such as maintenance, labor, and chemicals. Distinct from the tariff's own fixed charge (which EECO includes in the electricity cost).
fixed_operating_cost.title: Fixed Operating Cost

interest_rate.description: Optional annual cost of capital (fraction, e.g. 0.06). When given, the capital recovery factor uses the effective rate (1 + interest_rate) / (1 + discount_rate) - 1. Omit to use discount_rate alone.
interest_rate.title: Interest Rate

lifetime_years.description: Plant lifetime in years (> 0), used with the effective rate to form the capital recovery factor that annualizes capital cost.
lifetime_years.title: Lifetime Years

name.description: Name of the costing block on the model.
name.title: Name

prorate_monthly_charges.description: Prorate a tariff's monthly-assessed demand charge and fixed (customer) charge to the horizon length when the horizon is shorter than the calendar month it starts in. False bills the full monthly charges.
prorate_monthly_charges.title: Prorate Monthly Charges

tariff_source.description: Where the EECO tariff comes from: one file or tag, a list of them to merge, or a mapping of EECO utility ('electric'/'gas') to file to merge and also assign each file to a utility. Omit to price every carrier from energy_prices instead.
tariff_source.title: Tariff Source

CostingElement.title: CostingElement

DRConfig.description: Demand-response container slot, a placeholder in v0: DR containers exist so wiring is stable, but no DR constraints are built. Turning DR on later is additive.

events_source.description: Optional file or tag pointing at demand-response events.
events_source.title: Events Source

DRConfig.title: DRConfig

DispatchElement.description: Values an external controller sets for one variable of a unit.

fix.description: Whether to fix the variable to the values (removing its degrees of freedom).
fix.title: Fix

name.description: Optional label; not used to build anything.
name.title: Name

unit.description: Name of the unit element it applies to.
unit.title: Unit

values.description: One value per time point as a list, a mapping of time index to value, or a $source reference to a file holding either.
values.title: Values

variable.description: Name of the time-indexed variable on the unit.
variable.title: Variable

DispatchElement.title: DispatchElement

name.description: Local variable name on the unit block.
name.title: Name

role.description: Whether the variable is a process input or output.

tag_hint.description: Optional historian-tag hint for FlexParameterize aliasing.
tag_hint.title: Tag Hint

time_indexed.description: Whether the variable is indexed over the time set.
time_indexed.title: Time Indexed

units.description: Units of the variable as a string, e.g. 'm^3/hr'.
units.title: Units

IOVariableSpec.title: IOVariableSpec

name.description: Dotted path of the network on the model.
name.title: Name

costing_package.description: Name of the costing element whose cost is optimized; 'auto' means the model's only one.

name.description: Dotted path of the plant on the model.
name.title: Name

name.title: Name

options.description: Keyword options passed to the property-package constructor, e.g. {'has_pressure': true}.
options.title: Options

property_class.description: Name of a flexops property-package class, e.g. 'SimpleAqueousFlow' or 'SimpleGasFlow'.

values.description: The set's members, in order; non-empty and unique.

$source.description: Path of a .json or .json.gz file, relative to the spec file.

SourceRef.title: SourceRef

value.description: The numeric price: one number, one per time point, or a $source reference to a file holding that list.

data.title: Data

name.description: Optional label; not used to build anything.
name.title: Name

provenance.description: Free-form fit metadata (metrics, data window, versions).

relation.description: Name of the unit's relation to replace.

Each member names a class in flexops.surrogates that validates and builds the relationship; CONSTANT_INTENSITY is the one exception -- it has no class, since it fixes a process parameter rather than swapping a Constraint (see flexops.core.ops_block.OpsBlockData.swap_relation).

TimeElement.description: The discrete-time horizon; builds the model's time_block.

end_date.description: Exclusive ISO-8601 end of the horizon.
end_date.title: End Date

start_date.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 start of the horizon.
start_date.title: Start Date

time_step.description: Time-step as a units-carrying expression string, e.g. '15 min'; parsed at build time.
time_step.title: Time Step

TimeElement.title: TimeElement

UnitCommitmentConfig.description: Per-unit unit-commitment configuration, a validated container. Every piece is optional except status.

conditional.description: Not yet built from config; must be left at its default. Conditional status implications between units.
conditional.title: Conditional

delays.description: Not yet built from config; must be left at its default. Upstream-linked startup-delay specification.
delays.title: Delays

dwell.description: Not yet built from config; must be left at its default. Whether to build minimum up/down-time (dwell) constraints.
dwell.title: Dwell

min_down.description: Not yet built from config; must be left at its default. Minimum number of steps the unit must stay down once stopped.
min_down.title: Min Down

min_up.description: Not yet built from config; must be left at its default. Minimum number of steps the unit must stay up once started.
min_up.title: Min Up

startup_shutdown.description: Not yet built from config; must be left at its default. Whether to build startup/shutdown transition logic.
startup_shutdown.title: Startup Shutdown

status.description: Whether the unit has an on/off status binary (a tank sets this False).
status.title: Status

UnitCommitmentConfig.title: UnitCommitmentConfig

connections.description: Arcs leaving this unit. Each arc is written once, on its source unit.
connections.title: Connections

construction_options.description: Keyword options passed to the unit-model constructor. A value {'$package': name} passes the named property_package element.
construction_options.title: Construction Options

costing_package.description: Name of a costing element. 'auto' means the model's only one; null leaves the unit uncosted.
costing_package.title: Costing Package

index.description: Name of a set element; the unit is built once per member.
index.title: Index

io_variables.description: Declared process input/output variables of the unit.
io_variables.title: Io Variables

name.description: Dotted path of the unit on the model.
name.title: Name

property_package.description: Name of a property_package element. 'auto' means the model's only one (an error if it has several); null gives the unit none.
property_package.title: Property Package

unit_commitment.description: Per-unit unit-commitment configuration. Unset (null) leaves the unit model's own default in force.

unit_model_class.description: Name of the flexops unit-model class to construct.
unit_model_class.title: Unit Model Class

elements.title: Elements

schema_version.description: Semantic schema version of this spec, an X.Y.Z string; mandatory, no default.
